description: Metadata registry describing Lake and Warehouse datasets for the Payments & Digital Wallet platform.

datasets.name: lake_cdc_events
datasets.intended_audience: Data Engineers, Platform Engineers, Audit Systems
datasets.description: Durable append-only bronze stream log capturing all raw insert, update, and delete CDC events from the transactional source database.

schema.name: sequence
schema.description: Monotonically increasing CDC event sequence number (LSN / offset equivalent).

schema.name: table_name
schema.description: Source table name associated with the change event.

schema.name: primary_key
schema.description: Primary key identifier of the changed entity.

schema.name: data
schema.description: JSON serialized payload containing full entity field state.

schema.name: captured_at
schema.description: UTC timestamp when the change event was captured.

datasets.name: wh_customers
datasets.intended_audience: Data Analysts, Product Analytics, Customer Operations
datasets.description: Silver layer curated current-state snapshot of customer accounts, reflecting latest status and soft-delete tracking.

schema.name: customer_id
schema.description: Unique primary key identifying the customer.

schema.name: updated_at
schema.description: Timestamp when customer profile was last updated.

schema.name: _cdc_seq
schema.description: Sequence number of the last applied CDC record.

schema.name: _deleted
schema.description: Soft-delete flag (true if entity was deleted in source).

datasets.name: wh_wallets
datasets.intended_audience: Financial Operations, Risk & Fraud Analytics, BI Teams
datasets.description: Silver layer current-state snapshot of digital wallet balances, owner relationships, and status.

schema.name: wallet_id
schema.description: Unique primary key identifying the wallet.

schema.name: customer_id
schema.description: Foreign key referencing the owning customer.

schema.name: currency
schema.description: Three-letter ISO currency code (e.g. USD, EUR).

schema.name: updated_at
schema.description: Timestamp when wallet balance or state was updated.

schema.name: _cdc_seq
schema.description: Sequence number of the last applied CDC record.

datasets.name: wh_merchants
datasets.description: Silver layer current-state snapshot of registered merchants.

schema.name: merchant_id
schema.description: Unique primary key identifying the merchant.

schema.name: _cdc_seq
schema.description: Sequence number of the last applied CDC record.

datasets.name: wh_transactions
datasets.intended_audience: Payment Operations, BI Analysts, Finance Teams
datasets.description: Silver layer current-state snapshot of transaction processing status, fees, amounts, and timestamps.

schema.name: transaction_id
schema.description: Unique primary key identifying the transaction.

schema.name: merchant_id
schema.description: Foreign key referencing destination merchant (if applicable).

schema.name: settled_at
schema.description: Timestamp when transaction was settled or finalized.

schema.name: _cdc_seq
schema.description: Sequence number of the last applied CDC record.

datasets.name: wh_ledger_entries
datasets.intended_audience: Financial Auditors, Compliance Officers, Risk Engineers
datasets.description: Silver layer current-state snapshot of double-entry accounting ledger records.

schema.name: entry_id
schema.description: Unique primary key identifying the ledger entry.

schema.name: balance_after
schema.description: Wallet balance after applying ledger entry.

schema.name: created_at
schema.description: Timestamp when ledger entry was recorded.

schema.name: _cdc_seq
schema.description: Sequence number of the last applied CDC record.
